title: Belgians break *Backyard* world record
hook: Geerts and Steyaert pass 119 yards: 120 hours without a break.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: As of 22 Oct, 14:56 CEST, Merijn Geerts and Ivo Steyaert of Belgium are the last two runners standing. They broke the individual record of 119 yards.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: One yard is a 6.7 km loop every hour. Belgium has 1,050 team yards, behind the USA on 1,120 and Australia on 1,069.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.c: The race ends when one runner is left. Belgium would need both runners to keep going about 35 more hours to pass the USA. Totals are provisional.

facts.claim: Geerts and Steyaert completed 120 yards, breaking the previous record of 119
Previous record 119 (Phil Gore); Belgium 1,050 vs USA 1,120, Australia 1,069; Belgium last country active
120 yards each, still running at yard 121; 804.7 km

caption:
NEWS: Belgians break the Backyard Ultra world record

As of 22 Oct, 14:56 CEST, Merijn Geerts and Ivo Steyaert (Belgium) have run 120 yards, about 805 km, beating the individual record of 119 yards at the Backyard Ultra World Team Championship. They were still running; totals are provisional.

Source: VRT NWS, Sporza
